messages:
Maya: Weekend poll — thinking of building a tiny rooftop herb patch (I’ve got planters + soil), or hit the new thrift strip on 3rd for costume inspo, or go to the late-night open mic at The Lantern (8pm Sat). Who's up for which? :seedling::mag::microphone:

Sam: Rooftop sounds amazing. I can bring a cordless drill and some staples. What time?

Jordan: I’ll join the thrift run in the morning — what time is that open?

Priya: Love rooftop. I have leftover potting mix and a pack of basil/thyme. Happy to bring. Also can do 9am meetup?

Alex: Thrift person here — I'm free 10:30am. If rooftop folks want to start earlier, I can join after. Also: thrift strip has 2-for-1 on vintage jackets this weekend.

Nina: Open mic! I want to finally try a 3-minute set (terrified). Would anyone come watch me and heckle gently? :grimacing: 

Leo: I can help with heavy lifting for rooftop and then swing by open mic later. If rooftop starts 9am, count me in.

Maya: Plan: rooftop 9am on the building roof (take the stairwell by kitchen), bring gloves/drill/planters if you have them. Thrift people meet 10:30am at the corner of 3rd & Elm. Open mic — meet a small crew at 7:45pm outside The Lantern if you want to go together. Does that work?

Sam: Sounds good. I’ll bring a small hand trowel and a bag of compost.

Jordan: I’ll meet the thrift crew at 10:30. @Alex let's share rides?

Priya: Basil + thyme reserved for Maya’s patch. :herb: 

Nina: Okay I'm doing it. If anyone wants to practice lines tonight, I’ll be on a quick call at 6pm — DM me. :sweat_smile: 

Alex: Sure, @Jordan. I'll drive — can fit two people.

Leo: Rooftop -> nap -> open mic. It's the perfect Saturday. :zzz: :microphone:

Maya: Awesome. If plans change, post here. Otherwise see rooftop crew 9am. :seedling:
